## E — Market signal: sharing the road: pedestrians, bicyclists, motorcyclists and commercial vehicles
Market research was not performed in this state worker pass and no CompetitiveIntel artifact was supplied, so the market pack for this topic is typed debt (SC-SHR-MARKET).
Open items: applicant volume, pass rates, seasonality, buyer persona, price expectations, verbatim voice-of-customer quotes, ad hooks and the named gap.
Manual-only observation, not market evidence: the section contrasts several road users with different duties (pedestrians, bicyclists, motorcyclists, trucks), which suggests a who-gets-what-space drill as an angle to test later.
No market figures are asserted; every figure waits for a sourced recon pass.

corpus_stability.reason: The South Carolina Driver's Manual prints a single edition line (Revised 06/2024) on its front cover; its disclaimer says legislative and SCDMV policy changes may make some content out of date until the agency incorporates them, and a possibly newer unlinked upload exists on the issuer site (freshness debt in the run jams), so the corpus is treated as revised at most about once a year, bound to the registered snapshot.
